+title: Show the tool call locations from the ACP ToolCallLocation values of the entry, with no kit ToolCallLocation copy
+---
+## What
+`ToolCallSource.locations` (`Sources/AgentViewKit/Items/ToolCallSource.swift`) makes a kit `ToolCallLocation` from each `ToolCallEntry.locations` value of the entry (`ToolCallLocation(path: $0.path.rawValue, line: $0.line)`). The owner rule says that a kit view binds directly to the model values and makes no kit copy of them. ^tjzvcyn found this conversion. That task did not change it, because its card names only the raw input, the raw output, the content, the error data, the unknown raw value and the plan entries.
+
+- [ ] `LocationChips` in `ToolCallView.swift` shows the ACP `ToolCallLocation` values of the entry directly (`path.rawValue`, `line`).
+- [ ] The record path (old `AgentThreadView(thread:actions:)`) gives its locations to the view through a bridge on the record, as `acpKind`, `acpStatus`, `JSONValue.acpValue` and `PlanEntry.acpEntry` do, or the view keeps one shared text function for both forms. Look at `AbsolutePath`: a record path can be relative.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No code in `ToolCallSource.swift` makes a kit `ToolCallLocation` from an entry.
+- [ ] A `tool_call_update` that adds a location shows the new chip in the open tool call body.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Items/ToolCallEntryViewHostedTests.swift`: a later update adds a location chip.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
